governance.notes: Permanent grant dates and the SRD R370 payment dates of 23 and 25 September 2026 are confirmed by SASSA. label: October 2026

Beneficiaries are paid in a batch on either 22 or 23 October depending on their personal 'Pay Day' date on the official SRD portal, not on both dates.

governance.source: SASSA official October 2026 SRD R370 payment dates announcement
governance.notes: Permanent grant dates for October 2026 (Older Persons 2 Oct, Disability 5 Oct, Children's 6 Oct) were confirmed by SASSA on 16 September 2026 and match the DSD-approved 2026/27 payment schedule; these payment days have now passed. SASSA's October 2026 SRD announcement confirms the R370 payment dates of Thursday 22 and Friday 23 October 2026. Beneficiaries are paid in a batch on either date according to their personal 'Pay Day' on the SRD portal, not on both dates. The SRD grant has also been extended until 31 March 2027. The fourth payment day for grants under review remains TBC and is shown as projected.

label: November 2026

srd.day: Expected in the last week of November — confirmed after mid-month

note: SASSA confirmed the revised November 2026 payment dates on 14 October 2026, brought forward ahead of the Local Government Elections public holiday on 4 November 2026: Older Persons will be paid Friday 30 October, Disability on Monday 2 November and Children's Grants on Tuesday 3 November 2026. The fourth payment day, Thursday 5 November 2026, is for beneficiaries whose grants fall within the review process. The SRD R370 date is paid in the last week of November and is only announced after mid-month — check the official SRD portal for your personal 'Pay Day'. All eligible beneficiaries will still be paid.

governance.source: SASSA media statement: SASSA announces revised November 2026 social grant payment dates ahead of Local Government Elections (14 October 2026)
governance.notes: Per SASSA's 14 October 2026 media statement (spokesperson Dr Paseka Letsatsi), the November 2026 payment cycle was brought forward because 4 November 2026 is the Local Government Elections public holiday. Revised confirmed dates: Older Persons 30 October, Disability 2 November, Children's Grants 3 November, and the fourth payment day (for grants under review) 5 November 2026. The National Treasury approved the revised dates. Verified directly against the official SASSA media statement PDF (sassa.gov.za), corroborated by SAnews/gov.za, IOL, SABC and The Citizen. All eligible beneficiaries will still receive their grants.
